name: crtsh
title: crt.sh (Certificate Transparency)
description: Subdomains and certificates of a domain from the Certificate Transparency logs through crt.sh: every logged certificate for a domain and its subdomains with the unique host names they name, and a single certificate as PEM. Needs network: Allowlist with crt.sh:443 (axross's proxy; nothing else is reachable).
notes: Passive: only crt.sh is asked, the domain itself is never contacted. crt.sh is a free service that is sometimes slow or overloaded; the tool then says so.
